from sage.all import *
K=QuadraticField(-1,'ii'); ii=K.gen()
R=PolynomialRing(K,names=['q1','q2','s1','s2','kap','hb']); F=R.fraction_field()
q1,q2,s1,s2,kap,hb=[F(x) for x in R.gens()]
qs=[q1,q2]; sig=vector(F,[s1,s2])
E=ExteriorAlgebra(F,names=['b1','b2','ci1','ci2','co1','co2','cm1','cm2','d1','d2'])
eg=E.gens()
b=list(eg[0:2]); ci=list(eg[2:4]); co=list(eg[4:6]); cm=list(eg[6:8]); ds=list(eg[8:10])
def basis(ix):
    a=E.one()
    for j in ix: a*=eg[j]
    return a
def diff_even(p,x):
    return sum((a.derivative(x)*basis(list(ix)) for ix,a in E(p).monomial_coefficients().items()),E.zero())
def diff_odd(p,j):
    ans=E.zero()
    for ix,a in E(p).monomial_coefficients().items():
        ids=list(ix)
        if j in ids:
            k=ids.index(j)
            ans+=(-1)**k*a*basis(ids[:k]+ids[k+1:])
    return ans
def nil_exp(p):
    ans=E.one(); term=E.one()
    for n in range(1,11):
        term=term*p/n
        ans+=term
        if term==0: break
    return ans
def mv(A,v):
    return [sum((A[i,j]*v[j] for j in range(2)),E.zero()) for i in range(2)]
def om(P,A,B,c):
    ac=mv(A,c); bc=mv(B,c)
    return sum((ii*hb*ac[i]*diff_even(P,qs[i])+kap*qs[i]*bc[i]*E(P) for i in range(2)),E.zero())
def curvature(A,B,c):
    ac=mv(A,c); bc=mv(B,c)
    return ii*hb*kap*sum((ac[i]*bc[i] for i in range(2)),E.zero())
one=identity_matrix(F,2)
Bopen=matrix(F,[[0,1],[0,0]])
Bclosed=matrix(F,[[2,1],[1,3]])
Bzero=matrix(F,[[2,0],[0,0]])
Azero=matrix(F,[[1,0],[0,0]])
polys=[q1**i*q2**j for i in range(4) for j in range(4-i)]
testP=[E(f)*g for f in polys for g in [E.one(),b[0],ci[1],b[0]*co[1]]]
closed_square=all(om(om(p,one,Bclosed,co),one,Bclosed,co)==0 for p in testP)
open_square=all(om(om(p,one,Bopen,co),one,Bopen,co)==curvature(one,Bopen,co)*p for p in testP)
open_nonzero=(curvature(one,Bopen,co)!=0)
Egh=nil_exp(ii/hb*sum((b[j]*(co[j]-ci[j]) for j in range(2)),E.zero()))
ghost_derivative=all(diff_odd(Egh,j)==ii/hb*(co[j]-ci[j])*Egh for j in range(2))
def ward(f,A,B):
    ash=A*sig; bsh=B*sig
    L=kap*sum((qs[i]-ash[i]/2)*bsh[i] for i in range(2))
    sub={qs[i]:qs[i]-ash[i] for i in range(2)}
    amp=Egh*E(f.subs(sub))
    def covd(P,x):
        return diff_even(P,x)+(ii/hb)*L.derivative(x)*P
    lap=hb**2*sum((covd(diff_odd(amp,j),sig[j]) for j in range(2)),E.zero())
    ac=mv(A,co);bc=mv(B,co)
    out=sum((ii*hb*ac[i]*covd(amp,qs[i])+kap*qs[i]*bc[i]*amp for i in range(2)),E.zero())
    incoming=om(E(f),A,B,ci)
    insh=sum((a.subs(sub)*basis(list(ix)) for ix,a in incoming.monomial_coefficients().items()),E.zero())
    lhs=lap+out-Egh*insh
    W=A.transpose()*B-B.transpose()*A
    rhs=kap/2*sum((sig[i]*W[i,j]*(co[j]+ci[j]) for i in range(2) for j in range(2)),E.zero())*amp
    return lhs,rhs
closed_ward=all(ward(f,one,Bclosed)[0]==0 for f in polys)
open_ward=all(ward(f,one,Bopen)[0]==ward(f,one,Bopen)[1] for f in polys)
open_ward_nonzero=ward(F.one(),one,Bopen)[1]!=0
zero_mode_ward=all(ward(f,Azero,Bzero)[0]==0 for f in polys)
constant_ghost_not_removed=diff_odd(Egh,1)!=0
bL=[b[j]+ds[j]/2 for j in range(2)]
bR=[b[j]-ds[j]/2 for j in range(2)]
left=nil_exp(ii/hb*sum((bL[j]*(cm[j]-ci[j]) for j in range(2)),E.zero()))
right=nil_exp(ii/hb*sum((bR[j]*(co[j]-cm[j]) for j in range(2)),E.zero()))
mid=hb**2*diff_odd(diff_odd(left*right,6),7)
target=ds[0]*ds[1]*Egh
glue_ghost=(mid==target)
push=diff_odd(diff_odd(mid,8),9)
glue_residual=(push==Egh)
raw_residual_not_state=(mid!=Egh)
# Nonzero elementary Berezin integral, signs independently anchored.
berezin_anchor=(diff_odd(diff_odd(eg[0]*eg[1],0),1)==1 and diff_odd(eg[0]*eg[1],1)==-eg[0])

# Mixed local Hessian: actual odd/even derivatives of sum sigma_j b_j.
def local_laplacian_count(n):
    Rn=PolynomialRing(QQ,names=['z'+str(j) for j in range(n)])
    En=ExteriorAlgebra(Rn,names=['eta'+str(j) for j in range(n)])
    zn=list(Rn.gens()); en=list(En.gens())
    fn=sum((zn[j]*en[j] for j in range(n)),En.zero())
    val=Rn.zero()
    for ids,coef in fn.monomial_coefficients().items():
        inds=list(ids)
        assert len(inds)==1
        val+=coef.derivative(zn[inds[0]])
    return val
local_trace_diverges=all(local_laplacian_count((2*n+1)**2)==(2*n+1)**2 for n in [0,1,2])

# An actual opposite-face diagonal operator: common ghosts are essential.
def opposite_diag(P):
    return ii*hb*co[0]*(diff_even(P,q1)+diff_even(P,q2))+kap*(q1-q2)*co[1]*E(P)
def unmatched(P):
    return ii*hb*(ci[0]*diff_even(P,q1)+co[0]*diff_even(P,q2))+kap*(q1*ci[1]-q2*co[1])*E(P)
opposite_diag_nilpotent=all(opposite_diag(opposite_diag(p))==0 for p in testP)
unmatched_not_nilpotent=unmatched(unmatched(E.one()))==ii*hb*kap*(ci[0]*ci[1]-co[0]*co[1]) and unmatched(unmatched(E.one()))!=0
